page.overview:
Who is Laser-Viper?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Laser-Vipers were introduced in the 1990 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: dark grey face mask; dark grey shirt with blue chest armor and gloves; dark grey pants with silver belt pockets and black boots

Accessories: silver full-head face mask with black visor; square, silver backpack with 2 detachable swivel cannons and supports, and one detachable, slotted control arm; two standard short, black hoses. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/90/laserviper.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/90/laserviper.shtml Filecard]
